scope.scope_basis: All exact workbook records at 3 Sakra Road / Oasis @ Sakra, Jurong Island. Read-only audit; no workbook edits.
rules: Separate site/facility/operator closure from individual tenant closure.
Apply access evidence at shared site level only when exact address confirms the row is within that site.
Do not infer a tenant closure from SFA current-list absence or generic venue/operator closure.

sources.observed: JTC states entry to Jurong Island is limited to staff and visitors with a valid Jurong Island Pass; pass sponsorship is required.
sources.interpretation: Strong evidence that an ordinary member of the public cannot freely enter the site. The five exact-address workbook records do not meet the database definition of generally public-accessible F&B.

sources.observed: MTI says the original food-court operator at Oasis @ Sakra ceased operations in Aug 2026; JTC was engaging potential replacements. Workers could use interim options including KJM Curry House and Oasis Café.
sources.interpretation: Venue/operator-level closure and transition. Does not name the original operator or confirm each licensed tenant’s closure. KJM/Oasis Cafe have positive presence evidence as of statement date.

records.access_basis: All five records are at Oasis @ Sakra, 3 Sakra Road, Jurong Island. JTC states entry to Jurong Island is limited to staff and visitors with a valid pass, and visitors require sponsorship; this is not ordinary unrestricted public access.
records.tenant_status_note: MTI (10 Sep 2026) specifically names KJM Curry House / Oasis Café as interim food options for workers at Oasis @ Sakra. Positive evidence of continued operation as of that statement; verify freshness before any operating-status assertion.
